r13_addendum.scope: Adds the tar-header metadata disclosure required by the independent R12 incremental review (P2-01) and records runner supersession. Does not rewrite any R12 historical receipt, hash, or claim recorded above.

verified_exact_difference_only_scope.meaning: Applies to REGULAR PAYLOAD BYTES and ARCHIVE PATH SETS only: all regular files compare byte-identical to the staged original except tools/<id>/meta.sh (TOOL_TOOL_ID -> TOOL_ID rename).
verified_exact_difference_only_scope.excludes: Tar header metadata (per-entry mode, mtime, uid, gid) and archive ordering. Candidate repacks regenerate tar headers, so original vs candidate archives differ at the header level even where payload bytes match; the payload-only claim above does not assert header equality.
verified_exact_difference_only_scope.established_header_discipline_reference: docs/tool-portfolio/r10/CANDIDATE_PACKAGE.json records the R10 candidate packaging method: tar --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner (deterministic epoch mtime, uid/gid 0). This R12 batch JSON did not record an equivalent packaging method or per-entry header table; that omission is the P2-01 gap disclosed here.
verified_exact_difference_only_scope.r13_attempt: R13 attempted to re-derive per-entry mode/mtime/uid/gid tables from the pinned candidate artifacts (R12 ZIP cc7d09aadcd2b55e707470afd361a686158b52163f2642ab2cc2b44e4e3cfb5b, R10 HiGHS candidate baab9138a6e86ee22afec7749ebf83d8a2055177d5c700e4c07d4c1ea3a2e5a5, R11 nuXmv candidate Drive id 1yjneRDGdgF5MAob2SKiCr3l3ZqqPe_wJ); every Drive fetch was rejected (gdown rate-limit 'many accesses' / non-public-link refusal, with and without cached cookies, from two networks, 2026-11-14). Original archives were NOT re-downloaded (R13 brief constraint: originals stay immutable). Per-entry header tables therefore remain UNDISCLOSED in-repo.
required_before_further_use: Extract per-entry mode/mtime/uid/gid for the four candidate archives from the pinned R12 ZIP (or record the exact packaging method that determines them, following the R10 pattern) into this file.

fixes: P1: unsafe tool IDs (traversal, absolute, separator, dot-segment) are rejected by a strict [A-Za-z0-9._-] no-leading-dot allowlist before any filesystem path is constructed, sourced, executed, or used in a receipt filename; sourced/executed bundle files (meta.sh, expect.sh, run shim, private lib dir) are symlink-contained inside tools/<id>/ (or tests/<id>/).
P2-02: doctor ldd probe is fail-closed — a nonzero ldd exit or an empty dependency listing is reported as probe FAILED, never as 'no missing libs OK'.

runner_supersession.impact_on_r12_candidates: The four R12 candidates (and the R10/R11 candidates) were produced and validated under the R12 runner blob. The fixed runner's stricter ID validation does not alter healthy-tool doctor/version behavior (all pre-existing Node cases pass unchanged), but candidates must be rebuilt with the fixed runner before any further admission use.
